summary: iter118p Batch 1+2 tested. Backend: 10/10 pytest tests passed via public URL — trainer-profiles reliability fields (onTimePercent, completedSessionsForReliability), trainee-no-show-action endpoint (auth guard, invalid action 400, wait updates session, refund-before-15min rejected, refund-after-15min flips status->no_show + trainerNoShow + refundPending + increments noShowStrikes), gps-checkin trainerLateCheckIn (>5min sets flag & trainerLateMinutes/trainerCheckedInAt; <=5min does not), and trainers/nearby still returns isBoosted bool. Frontend: Expo React Native app so Playwright isn't a fit; verified via source that all required data-testids and logic are present: trainee-home-hero-btn (TouchableOpacity), filter icon removed (no onFilterPress/SlidersHorizontal on home), confirm-booking trainer header card, trainer-reliability-badge chip on trainer-detail, trainer-row-{id}-promoted pill in TrainerBottomSheet, and trainee-no-show-banner with Wait/Refund buttons + escalation copy at >=30 min in session-detail.tsx.
critical_code_review_comments: trainee-no-show-action refund path only sets refundPending=true and increments noShowStrikes but does not trigger any refund/payment reversal. Confirm a downstream worker or admin job processes refundPending, otherwise refunds may silently stall.

gps_checkin lateness telemetry only tags trainerLateCheckIn when the check-in is within_radius. If the trainer checks in from outside the radius while very late, the session is never tagged as late. Consider tagging lateness independent of radius outcome.
profile_routes reliability computation counts no_show status in both numerator penalty and denominator; every no_show pulls onTimePercent down by (100/N). Acceptable but ensure product intent.

success_rate.frontend: verified via source (no runtime UI test on Expo RN)

seed_data_creation: Ephemeral sessions created directly in Mongo with TEST_iter118p=true; each test cleans its own session doc. noShowStrikes counter reverted after refund test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend endpoints for iter118p Batch 1+2 fully covered by /app/backend/tests/test_iter118p_batch12.py (pytest, 10 tests, ~3s runtime).
